ticker_news.title: The First 3 Stocks I'm Buying if the Market Crashes
ticker_news.description: The author recommends Microsoft, Alphabet, and Amazon as top stocks to buy during a market crash. These companies are resilient due to their essential business services: Microsoft's Office and cloud products won't be cancelled, Alphabet's advertising business will recover strongly, and Amazon's AWS cloud platform generates unavoidable recurring revenue. While all three will decline during a crash, they are positioned to emerge stronger on the recovery side.
ticker_news.author: Keithen Drury
